name: BitBoy 2000
description:
The most advanced screen for displaying your NFTs! First released in 1999, this screen was praised for its ability to reproduce up to 56 different shades of green! Just make sure to have a good source of light when viewing.

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
